newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-FRENCH PLAYERS FACE EXAMINATION BY VIDEO.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRENCH PLAYERS FACE EXAMINATION BY VIDEO.

text.p: Welsh rugby officials were studying videos on Thursday before deciding whether to take any further action over several off-the-ball incidents during Wednesday's international against France.
Welsh fly-half Neil Jenkins claimed he was spat at by French centre Richard Dourthe, who was also involved in a nasty clash with opposite number Leigh Davies.
Lock Olivier Merle was another French player to be singled out by Welsh players after prop Christian Loader suffered a facial injury in his side's 40-33 defeat.
"France produced some excellent rugby but I wasn't so impressed with some of their off-the-ball play," said Welsh coach Kevin Bowring.
